build_ShapeDataset: build a FairseqDataset that loads per-shape data including intrinsics and global features from directory paths
create_ShapeViewDataset: create a dataset containing rendered RGB images, depth, masks, and camera extrinsics for 3D object views
create_SampledPixelDataset: create a wrapper dataset that samples pixels from rendered images using mask or bounding box strategies
create_WorldCoordDataset: create a wrapper dataset that transforms UV coordinates into world space ray directions and origins
create_InfiniteDataset: create a wrapper dataset that enables infinite cyclic sampling from an underlying dataset with no epoch boundaries
